content.short: Audius is a blockchain protocol that functions as a decentralized digital streaming service.
content.description: Audius is a decentralized music streaming protocol built on Solana that targets the inefficiencies of the music industry, including opaque rights ownership and the intermediaries that stand between artists and their audiences. Through its native AUDIO token, Audius seeks to align the interests of artists, fans, and node operators, supporting a more direct and transparent ecosystem. Artists upload music that is stored and distributed by content and discovery nodes, allowing fans to listen to tracks for free on the network.
